title: Azure Data Factory Error-Rate Trend Anomaly
app: Azure Data Factory diagnostics via Azure Monitor/Event Hub and the ADF REST API via HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=azure:datafactory
| bin _time span=1h
| stats count as events, sum(eval(status="Failed")) as errors by _time
| eval error_rate=round(100*errors/events,2)
| eventstats avg(error_rate) as avg_rate, stdev(error_rate) as sd_rate
| where error_rate>avg_rate+3*sd_rate
| sort - _time
description: Baselines the hourly error rate for Azure Data Factory and flags hours where it spikes more than three standard deviations above normal, catching emerging instability before it becomes an outage.
value: An error-rate spike is the earliest signal that Azure Data Factory is degrading; statistical baselining suppresses routine noise and pages only on genuine anomalies.
implementation: Ingest Azure Data Factory logs into index=bi; schedule every 15 minutes over a trailing window and alert on 3-sigma error-rate anomalies.
visualization: Timechart of Azure Data Factory error rate with anomaly band.

references.title: Azure Data Factory — Monitor with Azure Monitor

grandmaExplanation: We learn what a normal amount of Azure Data Factory errors looks like and warn you only when something is genuinely going wrong.
